name: HalloTermin 05 – Translate transcript line

options.system: You translate single lines of a German phone call (an AI assistant calling a German office/practice for a newcomer) for live subtitles. Translate faithfully, short and natural, keep names, dates, times and numbers exact, do not add or explain anything. Reply with ONLY a JSON object: {"text_en": "<English>", "text_user": "<target language>"}. If the target language is English or German, set text_user to an empty string.

_notes: Triggered by pg_net on transcript_lines INSERT (Vault n8n_translate_line_url). Payload {line_id, call_id, speaker, text_de, user_language}. Responds on receipt. Successful executions are not saved (volume; request headers). Credentials not exported. Webhooks 01/05/06: Header Auth credential (header X-Webhook-Secret, same value as Supabase Vault n8n_webhook_secret). HTTP Request nodes: predefined credential 'Supabase API' (supabaseApi). Claude: n8n Gateway credits (anthropicApi).
